purpose: Bounded, zero-cloud-cost, non-final M3.2 pilot to decide whether additional compute is justified.

bundle.statistic: FastMetric exact-equivalent to reference _metric; use unchanged

hypotheses.sentinel_role: descriptive_only; never an admission, Gate 2, referee, or search result

execution.active_services: live trading kernel and dashboard remain active

runtime_estimate.basis: 18,585 measured/calibrated full-run CPU-hours divided by 75,000 worlds

outcome.effect_scale: signed target lift from the unchanged world receipts

thresholds.refusal_blocker: STOP if either world refusal rate or hypothesis refusal rate is > 1 percent, using the unchanged refusal logic
thresholds.null_failure: STOP if either N0/C0 or N3/C4 has rejecting_worlds / non_refused_worlds >= 0.25
thresholds.wrong_direction: STOP if either positive cell has median signed target lift <= -0.01 and at least 12 of its 20 non-refused worlds have non-positive signed target lift
thresholds.negligible_positive_effect: STOP if both positive cells have absolute median signed target lift < 0.01
thresholds.encouraging_effect: GO candidate if at least one positive cell has median signed target lift >= 0.01 and at least 12 of its 20 non-refused worlds have positive signed target lift
thresholds.significance: absence of statistical significance with 20 worlds is never, by itself, a STOP condition

outcome.precedence: integrity/refusal STOP, then clear null/wrong-direction/negligible-effect STOP, then clean encouraging effect GO, otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
outcome.non_final_language: All pilot outputs are pilot/non-final engineering and statistical diagnostics. They do not validate M3.2, establish Gate 2 evidence, admit search, enable referee or handoff, or authorize live trading.
